cues: Simple harmonic motion means acceleration proportional to displacement and directed towards the mean: a equals minus omega squared x. Speed is greatest in the middle, acceleration at the ends.
The period is two pi over omega.
Energy swaps between kinetic and potential, with a constant total of half k A squared.
On a vertical spring, gravity just shifts the mean.
A pendulum's period is two pi root L over g for small swings.
Damping makes the amplitude decay exponentially, and resonance happens when the driver matches the natural frequency.
text: Let us recap. Simple harmonic motion means acceleration proportional to displacement and directed towards the mean: a equals minus omega squared x. Speed is greatest in the middle, acceleration at the ends. The period is two pi over omega. Energy swaps between kinetic and potential, with a constant total of half k A squared. On a vertical spring, gravity just shifts the mean. A pendulum's period is two pi root L over g for small swings. Damping makes the amplitude decay exponentially, and resonance happens when the driver matches the natural frequency.
